text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: Streaming proxy latency spike detected on service/redwood-streaming. p95 -> 800ms (normal 120ms), p99 -> 4.2s. Error bursts and stalled SSE/streams reported. Paging oncall: @tim_oncall

Tim Oncall: I'm on it. Can someone tag recent deploys or config changes?

sara_sre: seeing correlated bump with a rollout of the int8 calibration profile (calib-v3) to canary subset ~10:35 UTC. Metrics show taily token generation times and KV cache misses increasing.

mike_ml: oof. calib-v3 included a new dequant kernel path for longer contexts. We measured perf in staging but not with production stream shapes. Rolling back canary now?

zoe_runtime: Starting rollback of calib-v3 from canary nodes -> reverting to calib-v2 on 4 nodes (ids: gpu-22,gpu-23,gpu-24,gpu-25). ETA ~3m.

anya_support: Support reports customer A and B seeing aborted streams and multiple reconnects, elevated 429s from client-side timeouts. Customers flagged possible data loss for streaming ops.

Tim Oncall: Scaling up dedicated streaming pool by +2 replicas while rollback progresses. Routing policy set to prefer dedicated pool for streaming routes.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated: rollback/calib-v3 -> calib-v2 by zoe_runtime at 2427501489.

mike_ml: Adding note: int8 profile had slightly different quant scaling for KV caches. On long contexts we saw more frequent cache invalidations which cause full decode replays — explains p99 spikes.

ryan_prod: Any immediate customer mitigation we can surface? Can we offer a failover to fp16 variant for impacted tenants?

zoe_runtime: Yes. Implementing model-fallback rule: if stream tail latency > 1.5s for 30s, route to fp16-compat model (model-id: rwd-base-fp16) with throttled concurrency. Pushing routing change.

Tim Oncall: Change applied. route-policy/stream-fallback updated at 2427501820.

sara_sre: Observability: p95 dropped to 300ms shortly after rollback started, p99 at 1.8s and moving down. KV-cache miss rate back to baseline on nodes rolled back. Still seeing isolated stalls correlated with older canary nodes.

mike_ml: Running quick check: calibration histograms show a bimodal distribution after calib-v3 — some layers quantize fine, others produce outlier attention scale that triggers more dequant ops. Need deeper look before full rollout.

anya_support: I've messaged affected customers with temporary mitigation steps and ETA. They've acknowledged. Ticket numbers: CUST-A #7892, CUST-B #7910.

Tim Oncall: Oncall handoff note: I'll stay until p99 < 800ms for 15m, then escalate to next rotation. Sara, can you own postmortem for infra changes? Mike, can you lead ML root cause? Zoe pls confirm fix patch plan.

sara_sre: I can own postmortem. I'll collect traces, SLO breach windows, and DAS logs.

mike_ml: I'll bisect calib-v3 changes and run repro with long-context streaming workload. Suspect the quant scale update combined with KV eviction thresholds.

zoe_runtime: Patch plan: revert calibration changes that altered kv-scaling, add additional unit test around streaming long-contexts, and add canary traffic shape that mimics production streaming. Will open PR and gate rollout behind perf test.

incident-bot: NOTE: SLO breach window recorded 2427501123 -> 2427503300. p99 peaked at 4.2s. p95 peaked at 800ms.

Tim Oncall: Rolling close loop: monitoring for 20m. If any new stalls or p99 > 1.5s we will enable emergency throttling and increase nodes.

sara_sre: I'll schedule a 1hr post-incident review with timelines and action items and tag infra, ml, runtime, and support.

anya_support: Customers request follow-up status and RCA when available. I'm preparing templated message.

mike_ml: Quick workaround idea for streaming: add a temporary small KV-prefill TTL extension to reduce eviction churn until we stabilize quant scales. Low risk config change. Thoughts?

zoe_runtime: That could help; let's do it only on dedicated streaming pool. I'll apply TTL +30s on cache entries for streams.

Tim Oncall: Apply change and watch.

incident-bot: change applied: stream-kv.ttl += 30s on dedicated pool at 2427502955 by zoe_runtime.

sara_sre: After cache-ttl bump and rollback complete, p95 ~140ms, p99 ~420ms and trending down. No new customer reports in last 10m.

Tim Oncall: Marking incident as mitigated for oncall purposes. Keeping status 'monitoring' for 2h.

ryan_prod: Action items summary: 1) Rollback calib-v3 -> done. 2) Add perf gate for canary with streaming-shaped workload -> Zoe. 3) Bisect & fix quant scaling -> Mike. 4) Postmortem + customer comms -> Sara/Anya. 5) Temporary KV-ttl bump to reduce churn -> Zoe -> done.

sara_sre: Filing incident postmortem draft and will include timeline, metrics (p95/p99), affected customers, and remediation plan.

mike_ml: Note for follow-up: test matrix should include int8 and fp8 variants across context lengths 512/2048/4096, streaming patterns, and KV-hotspot patterns. Also add autotest sim for quant calibration drift.

anya_support: I'll queue proactive outreach for top 5 impacted accounts and update status page.

Tim Oncall: handing off to next oncall at 2427504760. Next oncall: @sara_sre. Leaving brief inops.

sara_sre: Ack handoff. I'll continue monitoring and publish postmortem draft in 24h. :thumbsup:
